Welcome to Skybase Tycoon!
Start small and build the ultimate skybase empire! Expand your skybase, collect resources, and upgrade your setup while surviving the open air. 

💾 Auto-saving progress.
🔁 Rebirth system to progress faster.
🤗 Playing with friends gives everyone bonuses! (10% per friend)
🎟️ Special passes with exclusive perks.

🔓 Redeem codes to get rewards:
FLAPPY, SEASIDE, CODECASH 

🫂 Join our group and stay up to date with the latest news!
